artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Sigma_2 = \{a,b\}$ be a binary alphabet. Two finite words $u, v \in \Sigma_2^*$ are said to be 2-abelian equivalent, written $u \sim_2 v$, if $|u| = |v|$ and for every word $w \in \Sigma_2^*$ with $|w| \le 2$, the number of occurrences of $w$ as a (contiguous) factor in $u$ equals the number of occurrences of $w$ as a factor in $v$. A 2-abelian square of period $p$ is a nonempty word of the form $uv$ with $|u| = |v| = p$ and $u \sim_2 v$. An infinite word $\mathbf{w} \in \Sigma_2^{\mathbb{N}}$ is said to avoid 2-abelian squares of period at least $k$ if no factor of $\mathbf{w}$ is a 2-abelian square of period $p$ for any $p \ge k$.

Determine the minimum integer $k$ with $2 < k < 60$ such that there exists an infinite binary word avoiding all 2-abelian squares of period at least $k$, or prove that no such $k$ in this range exists.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature on k-abelian repetition avoidance (notably work by Rao and Rosenfeld) establishes that 3-abelian squares of period at least 3 can be avoided over a binary alphabet and that 2-abelian squares of period at least 2 can be avoided over a ternary alphabet, but the exact threshold for avoiding 2-abelian squares of sufficiently long period over a binary alphabet does not appear to have been determined. The question is posed as an open problem, and no resolution was located in the search.

status_evidence.title: Avoidability of long k-abelian repetitions
status_evidence.snippet: 3-abelian-squares of period at least 3 can be avoided in infinite binary words; 2-abelian-squares of period at least 2 can be avoided in infinite ternary words.
status_evidence.claim: The closest known results concern 3-abelian squares on binary and 2-abelian squares on ternary, leaving the binary 2-abelian case open.

status_evidence.title: Every Binary Pattern of Length Greater Than 14 Is Abelian-2-Avoidable
status_evidence.snippet: Bounds on abelian-2-avoidability of binary patterns are studied but the specific minimum-period threshold for 2-abelian squares on two letters is not pinned down.
status_evidence.claim: No published value of the minimum k for avoiding binary 2-abelian squares of period at least k was found.
